news.content: Started my Master's degree in Computer Science at UFMG.
Obtained my Bachelor's degree in Computer Science at UFMG.
Presented my undergraduate thesis, titled "Formalizing and verifying an automata-based string calculus within the Carcara proof checker".
Our work on "Análise e Predição da Química entre Jogadores com base em Dados de Evento" was selected for a poster presentation at FAME 2025.
